usedFor: anny produces the invoices and bookings; Dropbox is the folder where you keep the paperwork. A “New Invoice” in anny can run “Upload File to Dropbox” and file a copy away.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in anny, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each generated invoice is saved to a chosen folder, with a setting for whether an existing file is added, replaced or updated.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” saves a file from a public web link, so the trigger has to give you a reachable file URL. Decide up front how existing files are handled: add, replace or update.
